description: Публичен регистър на свлачищните райони is a dataset listed in Open Data Bulgaria, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.mrrb.government.bg. For the registration of landslide processes on the territory of the Republic of Bulgaria there are three centres: Geoprotection Pernik, Geoprotection Pleven and Geoprotection Varna. Coverage: BG. The portal shows the English title as "Public register of landslide areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Геозащита Варна, Геозащита Перник, регистър, МРРБ, геозащита, Геозащита Плевен. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-bulgaria.
